what: Figure 1 — NSW meshing trends, all species
title: Ecological workflows
text: One panel per species (stacked vertically). Hover year percent change.
code: p_reid <- ggplot(reid_plot, aes(x = year, y = pct_change, colour = common_name, group = common_name)) +   geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey55") +   geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +   geom_point(size = 1.2, alpha = 0.85) +   facet_wrap(~ common_name, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +   scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 6)) +   scale_colour_viridis_d(option = "viridis", end = 0.9) +   labs(     title = "Relative change in meshing-program index — NSW",     subtitle = "Reid et al. (2011); baseline = first year in each series",     x = "Year",     y = "Change from baseline (%)",     caption = "Data: Sharkipedia reference reid2011 · sharkipediaR"   ) +   theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +   theme(     panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),     strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0)   )  ggplotly(p_reid, tooltip = c("year", "pct_change", "common_name"))
